title: CFI-G per-test conditions and observed outcomes
description: Every test point in the two PSI-159 experimental tables, normal and inverse kept separate. Conditions are inputs; hot ignition, termination mode, burn time, peak burner temperature and colour are observations.

field_specs.variable: Flame configuration (normal: fuel from burner; inverse: oxidizer from burner)
field_specs.transform: case-normalized; file of origin also recorded

field_specs.variable: Test day (YYDDD) and ISO date
field_specs.transform: first five digits of the test ID; YYDDD -> calendar date

field_specs.variable: Hydrocarbon fuel species
Fuel percentage in the fuel bottle (balance N2), from the fuel label
Ambient O2 mole fraction before the test (normal flames)
Ambient O2 mole fraction after the test (normal flames; post-test value, not a predictor)
Fuel mole fraction in the burner supply (normal flames)
Hydrocarbon mass flow from the burner (normal flames)
Ambient fuel mole fraction before the test (inverse flames)
Ambient fuel mole fraction after the test (inverse flames; post-test value)
O2 mole fraction in the burner supply (inverse flames)
O2 mass flow from the burner (inverse flames)
'HC burnrate' (inverse flames): equals O2 flow / stoichiometric O2-to-fuel mass ratio
field_specs.note: Checked by SpaceFire: ratio O2 flow / HC burnrate matches the stoichiometric mass ratio for every row. It is a stoichiometric-equivalent rate, not a measured fuel consumption.

field_specs.variable: Chamber pressure (approximate, as labelled)
Chamber pressure converted for comparison with Flame Design
Adiabatic flame temperature (calculated by the investigators; method not documented in the CSV)
Stoichiometric mixture fraction (calculated by the investigators; method not documented in the CSV)
Thin-filament pyrometry fibres used (instrument flag, not a measurement)
Hot ignition observed
How the run ended: SE (self-extinguished) or FT (flow terminated)
Outcome category derived from hot ignition + termination
Burn time
field_specs.note: Uncensored only when termination is SE; right-censored when FT.

field_specs.variable: Burn time is right-censored (FT)
Peak burner temperature
field_specs.raw_column: Peak burner T (C ) / Peak burner Temp (C)

field_specs.variable: Peak burner temperature in K as given in the inverse CSV
Flame colour as recorded by the team (inverse flames)
field_specs.transform: lower-cased; 'limit' kept and flagged as undefined

field_specs.variable: Cool-flame annotation (normal table column 'Cool flame?')
PCI-A ... PCI-G label in the 'Cool flame?' column (meaning not documented locally)

notes: Normal (179) and inverse (154) test points are separate groups: the reactant placement is reversed.
Burn time is an extinction time only for SE rows; FT rows are right-censored and must not be read as extinction times.
Tad and Zst were calculated by the investigators; their calculation method is not documented in the CSV.
Post-test columns (XO2 after, Xf after) describe the vitiated atmosphere after the burn; they are not inputs.
The inverse CSV contains 861 trailing blank rows; they are not test records.

outcome_definitions.self_extinguished: Hot flame ignited and self-extinguished (SE). Burn time is the observed time to extinction.
outcome_definitions.flow_terminated: Hot flame ignited; the run ended when the flow was stopped (FT). Burn time is right-censored: the flame was still burning.
outcome_definitions.not_ignited: No hot ignition ('-' in the termination column).
outcome_definitions.no_hot_ignition_flow_terminated: No hot ignition recorded, yet FT recorded (one normal test).
